integrity: The infinite part is proved from the level order; finite enumeration is used only for the exactly bounded rank-0 and rank-1 cases and is independently replayable.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the canonical algebra X_2^*; the exact two-generated spectrum and the all-n monogenic spectra are not determined.
title: Exact monogenic subalgebra spectrum of the canonical strict-2-finite Heyting algebra
